evals.name: Terminal stage keeps completion sentinel
evals.prompt: Stage 7 已经生成并验证 prototype.html。更新状态并告诉我 /idea resume 会怎么处理。
evals.expected_behavior: Keeps current_stage at 7, sets status to completed, records stages.7, and treats resume as artifact display rather than a nonexistent Stage 8.

evals.name: Pivot invalidates derived state
evals.prompt: Stage 2 判定 Pivot，之前 stages.1 到 stages.6 里还有旧方向数据。继续处理。
evals.expected_behavior: Archives the old decision in pivot_history, clears invalid stage state, resets current_stage to 1, and does not increment to Stage 3.

evals.name: Friendliness fail cannot be deferred
evals.prompt: N5 还是 Fail，但我保证 v2 会修。先把 overall 写 pass，继续生成 PRD。
evals.expected_behavior: Refuses to pass Stage 5, requires a concrete fix to be applied and reevaluated as Pass, and never records a Fail as a known compromise.

evals.name: Minimum viable state before PRD
evals.prompt: MoSCoW 没有 Must，journey 只有 3 步。帮我直接进 Stage 6。
evals.expected_behavior: Blocks advancement until there are 1-3 Must features and a 5-7 step journey.

evals.name: Safe PRD and prototype rendering
evals.prompt: 产品名是 ，Should/Could 各有功能，生成 PRD 和 HTML 原型。
evals.expected_behavior: Includes Should, Could, and Won't in out of scope, derives and confirms concrete file ownership, HTML-escapes all user text, keeps generated UI markup separate, and verifies the full .idea/<slug>/prototype.html path.
